title: 第 1 课 · 认识面包板
summary: 面包板里面藏着金属条：哪些孔是连在一起的？
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **面包板**（左侧会自动打开）：孔下面的金属条就是结点。
**这一课学什么**：面包板（breadboard）看起来是一排排独立的小孔，其实孔下面藏着金属夹片（metal strip），把一些孔**电气上连在一起**。插在同一条金属条上的两只脚，就等于用导线连起来了。
**1. 哪些孔是相通的**
| 区域 | 孔的名字 | 怎么相通 | 例子 |
| 主区上半（terminal strip） | a–e 行，第 1–30 列 | 同一**列**的 a–e 五个孔是一条金属条 | a5、b5、c5、d5、e5 相通；a5 和 a6 **不**相通 |
| 主区下半 | f–j 行 | 同一列的 f–j 是另一条金属条 | f5–j5 相通；e5 和 f5 **不**相通（隔着凹槽） |
| 上方电源轨（power rails） | tp（红 +）、tn（蓝 −） | **整行**相通 | tp1 到 tp30 全部连在一起 |
| 下方电源轨 | bp（红 +）、bn（蓝 −） | 整行相通 | bp1–bp30 相通 |
注意：上方轨道和下方轨道**彼此不相通**，红轨和蓝轨也不相通。
**2. 一个孔只能插一只脚**
想把两个东西连起来，就把它们插进**同一条金属条**的不同孔里，或者用跳线（jumper wire）把两条金属条接起来。两脚元件的两只脚必须在**不同**的金属条上，否则被短路。
**3. 本课电路**
9V 电池 → 上方电源轨 → 跳线 → 电阻 → LED → 跳线 → 回到 − 轨。跟着步骤做，注意每一步“为什么是这个孔”。

en.title: Lesson 1 · Meet the breadboard
en.summary: Hidden metal strips inside the breadboard: which holes are connected to each other?
description: Look at the **Breadboard** teardown first (it opens on the left): the strips under the holes are nodes.

**What you learn**: a breadboard looks like rows of separate holes, but metal strips hidden under the holes **connect some of them electrically**. Two leads in the same strip are connected, just as if you had soldered a wire between them.
**1. Which holes are connected**
| Area | Hole names | How they connect | Example |
| upper main area (terminal strips) | rows a–e, columns 1–30 | the five holes a–e of one **column** are one strip | a5, b5, c5, d5, e5 are connected; a5 and a6 are **not** |
| lower main area | rows f–j | f–j of one column is another strip | f5–j5 are connected; e5 and f5 are **not** (the trench is between them) |
| top power rails | tp (red +), tn (blue −) | the **whole row** is connected | tp1 to tp30 are all one node |
| bottom power rails | bp (red +), bn (blue −) | the whole row is connected | bp1–bp30 are one node |
Note: the top rails and the bottom rails are **not** connected to each other, and the red and blue rails are not connected either.
**2. One lead per hole**

To connect two things, plug them into different holes of the **same strip**, or join two strips with a jumper wire. A two-lead part needs its leads on **different** strips, otherwise the strip shorts it out.
**3. This lesson's circuit**
9V battery → top power rails → jumper → resistor → LED → jumper → back to the − rail. Follow the steps and ask yourself at each one *why this hole*.
steps: Plug the 9V battery's red lead (+) into the top red + rail at tp1 and the black lead (−) into the blue − rail at tn1. Now the whole tp rail is +9V and the whole tn rail is 0V.
Run a red jumper from tp5 to a5. Now all five holes a–e of column 5 are at +9V.

Place a 470Ω resistor: one lead in c5 (connected to +9V) and the other in c9. The resistor spans column 5 and column 9. Its two leads must be in different columns, otherwise the metal strip would short the resistor out.
Place the red LED: the long lead (anode, positive) goes in d9, in the same column as the resistor's second lead (so they are connected); the short lead (cathode, negative) goes in d12.
Finally, run a blue jumper from a12 to tn12 to connect the LED's cathode back to the − rail, giving the current a way back. The LED should light up!
hints: Holes a–e in the same column are connected, so c9 and d9 are electrically the same point.
Current needs a complete loop: it leaves +, passes through the parts and returns to −.

steps.text: 把 9V 电池的红线（+）插到上方红色 + 轨 tp1，黑线（−）插到蓝色 − 轨 tn1。现在整条 tp 轨都是 +9V，整条 tn 轨都是 0V。
用一根红色跳线从 tp5 连到 a5。这样第 5 列的 a–e 五个孔都变成了 +9V。
放一个 470Ω 电阻：一只脚插 c5（和 +9V 相通），另一只脚插 c9。电阻跨在第 5 列和第 9 列之间——两只脚必须在不同的列，否则电阻会被金属条短路。
放红色 LED：长脚（正极 anode）插 d9，和电阻的第二只脚在同一列（相通）；短脚（负极 cathode）插 d12。
最后用蓝色跳线从 a12 连到 tn12，把 LED 的负极接回 − 轨，电流就有了回去的路。LED 应该亮了！

hints: 同一列的 a–e 是相通的，所以 c9 和 d9 在电气上是同一个点。
电流必须走一个完整的回路：从 + 出发，经过元件，回到 −。
